niche_preference_profile: Prefers clean, structured interfaces with clear hierarchy, restrained decoration, and strong action emphasis. They usually favor light neutral surfaces with soft purple accents, open spacing, flat/minimal presentation, and simple direct content containers. They like organized card-based layouts when cards improve structure, but reject extra panels, shadows, or ornamental elements when they add clutter. They prefer concise text, clearer contrast for key elements, and strong primary CTA hierarchy. One strong outlier shows a clear liking for a dark high-contrast contact-list style UI with large rounded cards, minimal labels, and a single prominent pill CTA.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers minimal, unobtrusive interfaces with fewer decorative elements, fewer unnecessary containers, and less visual noise.
Prefers organized layouts with clearly separated sections, readable grouping, and strong content/action hierarchy.
Prefers consistent padding, open whitespace, and calmer layout rhythm over cramped or uneven spacing.
Prefers a clearly dominant primary action with strong contrast and less competition from secondary actions.
Usually prefers light neutral backgrounds with subtle purple accents and selective accent use, but also shows one strong exception favoring a dark high-contrast theme.
Prefers refined components with subtle borders, cohesive styling, stronger contrast where needed, and little to no shadow or elevation.
Prefers shorter copy, fewer labels/annotations, and cleaner rows that reduce textual density.
